rows.name: Node coordinates (paired by position)
rows.note: The nodes are paired by position; the delta is the Euclidean distance between a node and its nearest counterpart.

rows.name: Connectivity (end nodes of the members, I to J)
Local axes l1, l2 and l3
rows.note: The angle between corresponding vectors is the arc cosine of their normalised dot product, clamped to [-1, 1].

rows.name: Section properties (A, Ix, Iy, J)
rows.note: Evaluated by the signed verification sheet of the engineer; the program API does not expose section or material properties.

rows.name: Material properties (E, nu or G, unit weight)
rows.note: Evaluated by the signed verification sheet of the engineer; the program API does not expose section or material properties.

rows.name: Cardinal point, end offsets, stiffness factors, axial behaviour and springs
rows.note: Both models must carry the defaults exactly: centroid, no offsets, stiffness factors of 1, normal axial behaviour, no springs.

rows.name: Point loads on the members, by case with loads
rows.note: Largest difference of a load value, in percent of the manual value; largest difference of a load position 0 in.

rows.name: Category of the generated case with loads
Category of the manual case with loads
rows.note: Manual case category: DL (informative; the program never read back a category created in its interface).

rows.name: Self weight of the cases with loads
rows.note: Self weight multipliers: generated case REF1 (0, 0, 0); manual case REF1 (0, 0, 0) (informative).
